parts.text:
3
A value for the acceleration of free fall on Earth is given as (10  2) m s–2.
Which statement is correct?
A
The value is accurate but not precise.
B
The value is both precise and accurate.
C
The value is neither precise nor accurate.
D
The value is precise but not accurate.

hints: Notice the two parts of $(10 \pm 2) \text{ m s}^{-2}$: the central value $10$ and the absolute uncertainty $2$ in the same unit.
Recall that accuracy means closeness of the central value to the true $g$ near $9.81 \text{ m s}^{-2}$, while precision means a small spread or uncertainty.
Compare the $2$ to $10$ as a $20$% fractional uncertainty and check whether $9.81$ lies inside $10 \pm 2$ to decide each term.
walkthrough: Identify the given result: central value $= 10 \text{ m s}^{-2}$ and absolute uncertainty $= \pm 2 \text{ m s}^{-2}$, so the range is $8 \text{ m s}^{-2}$ to $12 \text{ m s}^{-2}$.
State the rules: accurate means close to the true value, precise means small uncertainty and a narrow, repeatable range.
Test accuracy: the true acceleration of free fall on Earth is about $9.81 \text{ m s}^{-2}$, and $10$ differs from this by only about $0.19 \text{ m s}^{-2}$, well within $\pm 2$, so it is accurate.
Test precision: fractional uncertainty $= 2/10 = 0.20$ or $20$%, which is a very wide range for $g$, so it is not precise.
Combine the two judgements: accurate but not precise. This is option A.

A.explanation: The central value $10 \text{ m s}^{-2}$ is close to the true $9.81 \text{ m s}^{-2}$ so it is accurate, but $\pm 2 \text{ m s}^{-2}$ is a large 20% uncertainty so it is not precise.

B.explanation: The large absolute uncertainty of $2 \text{ m s}^{-2}$ on $10 \text{ m s}^{-2}$ means the range $8$ to $12 \text{ m s}^{-2}$ is wide, so it cannot be described as precise.

C.explanation: The interval $8$ to $12 \text{ m s}^{-2}$ does include the true value near $9.81 \text{ m s}^{-2}$, so the result is not inaccurate.

D.explanation: Precision requires a small uncertainty, but here $\pm 2 \text{ m s}^{-2}$ is large, so the labels are the wrong way round.
